column1: # MSHR bank-hash: arms where a class that ACTUALLY ENTERS the MSHR reached fewer banks than
# the workload allows. Regenerated 2026-09-01 with the BYPASS GATE.
# A class with only ONE sharer per group has nothing to merge with, so mempool_group_mshr.sv:1454
# BYPASSES it entirely -- no entry, no bank, no hash. Scoring its spread is meaningless. 16 arms
# bypass the burst class and 40 bypass the single class; those classes are excluded here.
# 'ceiling' = distinct concurrent lines for the merging class, capped at 16 banks.
